title: Skipping a Tailwise Autoship Shipment
content:
**Tailwise Autoship — skip rules**

1. A customer may skip the next scheduled shipment. The subscription status is active when the skip is requested, as the subscription record shows it.
2. A change, skip or cancellation affects the upcoming shipment only if it is requested no later than the program's change cutoff days before the subscription's next ship date. The cutoff is counted in calendar days backward from the next ship date: a request dated exactly the cutoff number of days before the next ship date is in time, and a later request is late.
3. A late skip request leaves the upcoming shipment in place and skips the one after it.
4. A customer-requested skip is refused when either count below has already reached the program's limit; the alternatives then offered are a longer frequency or a pause.
   - **Rolling-year count.** The customer-requested skips of this subscription whose skipped scheduled ship dates fall within the rolling 365 calendar days ending on the request date, against the program's skip allowance per rolling 365 days. Automatic backorder skips are added to this count only where the program counts them toward the limits.
   - **Back-to-back count.** The customer-requested skips of this subscription on scheduled ship dates later than its most recent charged shipment, against the program's back-to-back allowance.
5. A shipment still out of stock the program's backorder days after its scheduled ship date is skipped automatically with the reason backorder, without charge, and counts toward the limits only when the program counts backorder skips toward the limits.
6. Every skip moves the next ship date forward by one frequency interval from the skipped date.

## Judgement table (hypothetical counts, program allowing 4 per rolling year and 1 back to back)

| Customer skips in the rolling 365 days | Customer skips since the last charged shipment | Skip request |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 0 | Granted |
| 4 | 0 | Refused: rolling-year allowance reached |
| 2 | 1 | Refused: back-to-back allowance reached |
| 3 | 0, with one backorder skip since the last charge, backorder skips not counted | Granted |

## Moving the date (hypothetical)

A subscription on a 4-week frequency whose skipped date is a given Monday gets a next ship date four weeks after that Monday. A request made after the cutoff for that Monday leaves the Monday shipment in place and skips the shipment four weeks later, whose following date is then four weeks after it.
